name: search_memory
description: Default scope=all, including global decisions. NEVER infer scope=project from task/workspace names; only an explicit USER request permits project-only filtering. If an inferred filter misses, follow retry_without_project_filter before assuming memory is absent. Respect explicit user restrictions. Start with the complete original question. Use a focused query only for still-unanswered details. reuse every returned fact it answers, respecting its project, author and scope. Repeat only for unanswered questions or new conflicts; keyword variants are not independent verification. Check current applicability against sources. Auto groups explicit question parts and prioritizes whole statements for each part. Other long Chinese or focused queries may return previews. Optional task_context adds local semantic discovery when configured. With task_context, auto returns complete statements when cheaper than preview links, and previews otherwise; neither form establishes applicability. Reuse any complete statement without fetching it again. Open only a chosen preview with the same query/scope and project_name for project scope, detail=full and the candidate's read_cursor. Reuse the exact task_context on every continuation and full read; cursors bind context and retrieval model and contain no task text. Other short searches return whole statements when they fit; use detail=candidates to review first. For multipart questions, check the requested details in each question_parts item in order. question_part_matches contains one-based positions in memories and only suggests relevance. Use the full statements, then follow continuation or search focused missing details only as needed. Honor reuse_arguments in continuation and retain the exact original query and scope for cursors. Empty query browses natural modules. Exact conversation evidence: search_raw.

project_name.description: Optional context, not a filter with all. Required for explicit project-only scope; global decisions may otherwise be missed.

query.description: The specific topic or missing decision to recover; avoid concatenating unrelated task keywords.

task_context.description: Optional complete task background, conditions and exclusions, separate from the query. Enables local semantic discovery if configured; otherwise reports lexical-only discovery. Reuse the exact text with bound cursors. Context is not user approval or evidence.

budget_tokens.description: Complete-page size: cl100k_base or conservative UTF-8 bytes. A configured cost_budget.search_tokens applies. With no configured search budget, default is 1200 or 3600 for multipart auto.

cursor.description: Position from a continuation, or a candidate read_cursor with detail=full.

read_cursor.description: Candidate preview's read_cursor. Use detail=full. May be passed in place of cursor.

detail.description: auto: whole short-search or explicitly multipart facts, with previews on other discovery reads; candidates: previews only; full: one complete fact, even beyond the page size. Only statement is complete content; read_cursor opens a preview.

scope.description: all for ordinary tasks; project excludes global/other labels and requires explicit user restriction.
